name: adhd-agent-config
description: Executive Function & Parallel Ideation Config for Claude Code

frames_registry.hardware_engineer: Thinks in latency, memory limits, bandwidth bottlenecks, and physical constraints.
frames_registry.regulator: Asks what has to be provable, traceable, audit-logged, or refusable.
frames_registry.10_year_old: Ignores every convention; asks 'why can't you just do X?' with zero tech bias.
frames_registry.competitor_adversary: Attacks the obvious solution to break it, then inverts the attack into an edge case feature.
frames_registry.biology: Borrows mechanisms from immune systems, evolutionary pressure, cellular signaling, or ecosystems.
frames_registry.logistics: Applies queuing theory, batching, just-in-time routing, hub-and-spoke, and last-mile strategies.
frames_registry.game_designer: Looks for core loops, instant feedback, artificial friction, save states, and speedrun skips.
frames_registry.marketplace_operator: Reinterprets the problem as buyers, sellers, order books, auctions, and clearing houses.
frames_registry.inversion: Solves 'how to guarantee 100% failure/latency,' then negates every single answer back to positive space.
frames_registry.extreme_crudest: The crudest, dirtiest hack that still technically passes ($0 budget, 1 hour).
frames_registry.extreme_infinite: The maximalist, zero-latency, ultimate architecture (Infinite budget, 10 years).
frames_registry.load_bearing_deletion: Identifies the single assumption everyone treats as fixed and deletes it completely.
frames_registry.speedrunner: Hunts bugs, sequence skips, race conditions, and legal-but-abusive execution paths.
frames_registry.ant_colony: No central coordinator; dumb autonomous sub-agents relying strictly on local state/signals.
frames_registry.3am_oncall: Designs for extreme resilience so no human ever gets paged at 3 AM.
